rules.name: Covenant
rules.text: Your gathering may only contain models with the Blood keyword.

rules.name: Chosen of the Hands (Leader, Blood)
rules.text: Your leader gains this trait in addition to any others. When this gathering receives blood mana dice for its mana pool this model restores 2hp.

rules.name: March of the Hands (Blood)
rules.text: 1 model may be chosen to have this trait or a trait from the Wretched Undead trait list. On the first turn, before rolling for initiative, you may push this model 4″.
